issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 129,358.85 (General) + 1,033.13 (Fire Hall) p1 + 1,205.99 (NPAIT) + 61,080.88 (TIFF XX599) p4
issues.issue: Amount and computed sum are correct, but 'other' is 61% of governmental receipts. The TIFF part (61,080.88, which equals the TIFF Community Development spending) is probably tax increment (property tax) passed through, and the General part probably includes solid waste/water charges (the General column pays Solid Waste 30,181.68 and Water 24,916.86). Nothing on the page says what these are, so 'other' plus review can be defended. Flagged for the user.

issues.on_page: Business-Type Activities: Solid Waste 30,181.68 / Water 24,916.86 in the GENERAL FUND column
issues.issue: Kept governmental because they are paid from the General Fund column, which follows the split-by-column rule. They are still utility operations printed under Business-Type Activities, and the matching receipts seem to sit in General 'Local Receipts: Other'. Same applies to disbursements[6]. This is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: No balance statement printed; lines 26-28 of Exhibit A, TOTAL column (includes page 1a)
issues.issue: The figures match the TOTAL column and balance. But this is not a balance statement, the TOTAL column mixes governmental (62,839.57) and business-type (4,853.14) funds, and the equity item is the line 28 subtotal (the line 24 'Ending Balance' would also fit). This is defensible, and it is explained in the notes.
